# SkyFX Trade

> Professional trading platform for Crypto, Forex and Commodities — real-time markets, advanced charts, secure execution, and INR/USD deposits.

SkyFX Trade is a multi-asset online trading platform serving retail and professional traders. The platform offers real-time pricing from Binance, CurrencyFreaks, and CoinGecko/FMP across crypto, forex, and commodities, with leverage, KYC verification, broker-managed deposits, and an Android mobile app.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SkyFX Trade — markets, features, security, and FAQ.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Create an account or sign in to start trading.
- [Reset Password](/reset-password): Password recovery flow.
